text_block_list.text: Ugh... I'm sorry, Trainer. I lost.

best I can
do right now...

text_block_list.text: Oh! What a nice way to put it!

text_block_list.text:

I'm still the
epitome of ordinary!

text_block_list.text:
I'm jumping back into training starting
today! My
first goal is to become a
slightly better kind of
ordinary!

get first
place by the next race!

regimen we
should do!
